label: تحديث
note: Story type UPDATE (patch). Primary: MADFINGER Games Steam changelog Patch 0.5.1.0 (store.steampowered.com/news/app/2479810, gid 1848664643340628, 5 Nov 2026 ~14:18 Dubai): over 40 changes to AI perception, combat behaviour, movement and cover; sound gives only an approximate location, accuracy falls with distance; AI shares approximate location by shouting; moving slowly lowers footstep detection; enemies react to light and use flashlights; Hideout economy rebalance; fix for 'different game version' invite error. Footage: Steam Rundown Trailer (official), committed copy, decode checked. Illustration, not demonstration. Sensitive: none, no violence shown. genre: shooter.
